turns.text: Hello darkness, my old friend
turns.zh: 你好啊黑暗，我的老朋友

turns.text: I've come to talk with you again
turns.zh: 我又来跟你说话了

turns.text: Because a vision softly creeping
turns.zh: 因为有个幻象悄悄爬进来

turns.text: Left its seeds while I was sleeping
turns.zh: 趁我睡着时留下了它的种子

turns.text: And the vision that was planted in my brain
turns.zh: 那个种在我脑子里的幻象

turns.text: Still remains
turns.zh: 至今还在

turns.text: Within the sound of silence
turns.zh: 在沉默的声音里

turns.text: In restless dreams, I walked alone
turns.zh: 在不安的梦里，我独自走着

turns.text: Narrow streets of cobblestone
turns.zh: 鹅卵石铺的窄街

turns.text: 'Neath the halo of a streetlamp
turns.zh: 在路灯的光晕下

turns.text: I turned my collar to the cold and damp
turns.zh: 我竖起衣领挡住又冷又湿的寒气

turns.text: When my eyes were stabbed by the flash of a neon light
turns.zh: 突然霓虹灯一闪，刺得我眼睛生疼

turns.text: That split the night
turns.zh: 那道光照亮了整个夜晚

turns.text: And touched the sound of silence
turns.zh: 也触到了沉默的声音

turns.text: And in the naked light, I saw
turns.zh: 在那赤裸的灯光下，我看见

turns.text: Ten thousand people, maybe more
turns.zh: 成千上万的人，也许更多

turns.text: People talking without speaking
turns.zh: 人们说着话却没有声音

turns.text: People hearing without listening
turns.zh: 人们在听却没有在听

turns.text: People writing songs that voices never shared
turns.zh: 人们写着歌，却从没人唱出来

turns.text: No one dared
turns.zh: 没有人敢

turns.text: Disturb the sound of silence
turns.zh: 去打破那沉默的声音

turns.text: "Fools", said I, "You do not know
turns.zh: 我说：「傻瓜，你们不知道

turns.text: Silence like a cancer grows
turns.zh: 沉默会像癌症一样蔓延

turns.text: Hear my words that I might teach you
turns.zh: 听我的话，让我教教你们

turns.text: Take my arms that I might reach you"
turns.zh: 抓住我的手臂，让我够到你们」

turns.text: But my words like silent raindrops fell
turns.zh: 但我的话像无声的雨滴落下

turns.text: And echoed in the wells of silence
turns.zh: 在沉默的井里回荡

turns.text: And the people bowed and prayed
turns.zh: 人们低头祈祷

turns.text: To the neon god they made
turns.zh: 向他们造出的霓虹之神

turns.text: And the sign flashed out its warning
turns.zh: 那招牌闪出了警告

turns.text: In the words that it was forming
turns.zh: 用正在成形的字句

turns.text: And the sign said, "The words of the prophets are written on the subway walls
turns.zh: 招牌上写着：「先知的话写在地铁墙上

turns.text: In tenement halls"
turns.zh: 写在廉租公寓的走廊里」

turns.text: And whispered in the sounds of silence
turns.zh: 在沉默的声音里低语着
